title: What’s Real? Love or Fear
fullTitle: Soul Feast #53: What’s Real? Love or Fear

promo.text: Are you ready to live Beyond the Five Sense? Learn How Here .

description: Fear often masquerades as reality through worry, jealousy, anger, or the belief that you are incomplete.

Yet these are illusions – perceptions created when a frightened part of your personality is active. Love, by contrast, is the compass of the soul. It is expressed as gratitude, patience, contentment, awe, and caring. Learning to recognize whether your experiences are born of fear or love is the key to stepping into the new consciousness now unfolding on Earth.

At its essence, this Soul Feast reveals that only love is real. Fear is an illusion. By choosing love over fear – moment by moment – you align your personality with your soul and begin to live from a place of authentic power.
What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:

This week, take out your Soul Notebook and write down the moments in your day when you notice yourself acting from fear—whether jealousy, resentment, or worry—or from love—such as gratitude, appreciation, or awe. At the end of each day, reflect: Which choices expanded you, and which contracted you? Over time, you will begin to see how choosing love consistently transforms your awareness and your life.
